STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_173390.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_173390.v · Open raw
module origen_173390(
    clk_50MHZ, reset, t, f,
    LCD_RS, LCD_E, LCD_RW, DATA_BUS
);

    input clk_50MHZ, reset, t, f;
    output reg LCD_RS, LCD_E, LCD_RW;
    inout wire [7:0] DATA_BUS;

    reg [7:0] str [0:15];
    reg [3:0] str_index;
    reg [15:0] counter;
    reg [3:0] state;
    reg [7:0] next_command;

    parameter HOLD = 4'd0, FUNC_SET = 4'd1, DISPLAY_ON = 4'd2, MODE_SET = 4'd3,
              PRINT_STRING = 4'd4, RETURN = 4'd5, DROP_LCD_E = 4'd6,
              RESET = 4'd7, DISPLAY_OFF = 4'd8, DISPLAY_CLEAR = 4'd9;

    reg [7:0] DATA_BUS_INTERNAL;
    assign DATA_BUS = (LCD_RW == 1'b0) ? DATA_BUS_INTERNAL : 8'bZZZZZZZZ;

    reg CLK_400HZ;
    always @(posedge clk_50MHZ or posedge reset)
    begin
        if (reset)
            counter <= 16'd0;
        else
            counter <= counter + 16'd1;
    end
    always @(posedge clk_50MHZ or posedge reset)
    begin
        if (reset)
            CLK_400HZ <= 1'b0;
        else if (counter == 16'd62500)
            CLK_400HZ <= ~CLK_400HZ;
    end

    always @(posedge CLK_400HZ or posedge reset)
    begin
        if (reset)
        begin
            state <= RESET;
            str_index <= 4'd0;
            LCD_RS <= 1'b0;
            LCD_E <= 1'b0;
            LCD_RW <= 1'b0;
            DATA_BUS_INTERNAL <= 8'b00111000; // Function set: 8-bit, 2-line, 5x7 dots
        end
        else
        begin
            case (state)
                HOLD:
                begin
                    LCD_E <= 1'b0;
                    if (t && f)
                        state <= PRINT_STRING;
                    else if (t)
                        state <= DISPLAY_ON;
                    else if (f)
                        state <= DISPLAY_OFF;
                end
                FUNC_SET:
                begin
                    LCD_RS <= 1'b0;
                    LCD_RW <= 1'b0;
                    DATA_BUS_INTERNAL <= 8'b00111000; // Function set: 8-bit, 2-line, 5x7 dots
                    LCD_E <= 1'b1;
                    state <= DROP_LCD_E;
                end
                DISPLAY_ON:
                begin
                    LCD_RS <= 1'b0;
                    LCD_RW <= 1'b0;
                    DATA_BUS_INTERNAL <= 8'b00001100; // Display on, cursor on, blink off
                    LCD_E <= 1'b1;
                    state <= DROP_LCD_E;
                end
                MODE_SET:
                begin
                    LCD_RS <= 1'b0;
                    LCD_RW <= 1'b0;
                    DATA_BUS_INTERNAL <= 8'b00000110; // Entry mode set: Increment cursor, no display shift
                    LCD_E <= 1'b1;
                    state <= DROP_LCD_E;
                end
                PRINT_STRING:
                begin
                    LCD_RS <= 1'b1;
                    LCD_RW <= 1'b0;
                    DATA_BUS_INTERNAL <= str[str_index];
                    LCD_E <= 1'b1;
                    state <= DROP_LCD_E;
                    if (str_index == 4'd15)
                        state <= RETURN;
                    else
                        str_index <= str_index + 4'd1;
                end
                RETURN:
                begin
                    LCD_RS <= 1'b0;
                    LCD_RW <= 1'b0;
                    DATA_BUS_INTERNAL <= 8'b10000000; // Return cursor to home position
                    LCD_E <= 1'b1;
                    state <= DROP_LCD_E;
                end
                DROP_LCD_E:
                begin
                    LCD_E <= 1'b0;
                    state <= HOLD;
                end
                RESET:
                begin
                    LCD_RS <= 1'b0;
                    LCD_RW <= 1'b0;
                    DATA_BUS_INTERNAL <= 8'b00110000; // Function set: 8-bit, 2-line, 5x7 dots
                    LCD_E <= 1'b1;
                    state <= FUNC_SET;
                end
                DISPLAY_OFF:
                begin
                    LCD_RS <= 1'b0;
                    LCD_RW <= 1'b0;
                    DATA_BUS_INTERNAL <= 8'b00001000; // Display off, cursor off, blink off
                    LCD_E <= 1'b1;
                    state <= DROP_LCD_E;
                end
                DISPLAY_CLEAR:
                begin
                    LCD_RS <= 1'b0;
                    LCD_RW <= 1'b0;
                    DATA_BUS_INTERNAL <= 8'b00000001; // Clear display
                    LCD_E <= 1'b1;
                    state <= DROP_LCD_E;
                end
                default:
                    state <= HOLD;
            endcase
        end
    end

    initial
    begin
        str[0] = "H";
        str[1] = "e";
        str[2] = "l";
        str[3] = "l";
        str[4] = "o";
        str[5] = " ";
        str[6] = "W";
        str[7] = "o";
        str[8] = "r";
        str[9] = "l";
        str[10] = "d";
        str[11] = "!";
        str[12] = " ";
        str[13] = " ";
        str[14] = " ";
        str[15] = " ";
    end

endmodule
